prompt:
**(a)** Find $\displaystyle\int x \ln x \, dx$. **[4]**

**(b)** Hence find the exact value of $\displaystyle\int_1^{e} x \ln x \, dx$. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** Parts with $u = \ln x$, $v' = x$ (M1): $\tfrac{x^2}{2}\ln x - \displaystyle\int \tfrac{x^2}{2}\cdot\tfrac{1}{x}\,dx$ (A1) $= \tfrac{x^2}{2}\ln x - \tfrac{x^2}{4} + C$ (A1)(A1)

**(b)** $\left[\tfrac{x^2}{2}\ln x - \tfrac{x^2}{4}\right]_1^{e}$ (M1) $= \left(\tfrac{e^2}{2} - \tfrac{e^2}{4}\right) - \left(0 - \tfrac{1}{4}\right)$ (A1) $= \tfrac{e^2 + 1}{4}$ (A1)
